gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: The preregistered natural-data coverage gate passed exactly: four distinct new recovery cells across two tracks, with positive steering in one and negative steering in four cells. This permits offline student feasibility only, not candidate driving score.
